svg.text: SO-101 · joint names across the stack
one robot, one set of names — what changes between layers is units, ranges and index order
URDF · MJCF · RViz · MuJoCo twin · F710
motor N in the bus → index N-1 in /joint_states
1 · the gripper is not a joint in the driver: it is a
percentage, 5 closed and 95 open on this arm
2 · elbow_flex and wrist_flex are pitch joints; only
3 · LeRobot degrees start at the calibration pose,
the model starts at zero — they are not the same
the same names in every layer
LeRobot bus · joint server :8002 · arm_bridge · /joint_states · URDF · MJCF · RViz · MuJoCo twin · F710
every hop keeps the joint order — only the unit changes
gripper is the odd one: the driver talks 0–100 %, the model -0.17 … +1.75 rad, and 5 = closed, 95 = open on the bench.
/joint_targets carries degrees and tolerates 5 values: with five the server leaves motor 6 untouched — hand-eye sweeps rely on it.
F710 teleop · which control moves which joint
joint-step is the default mode; START toggles it to cartesian-feel
limits: MJCF so101.xml · driver: lerobot_joint_server.py + f710_teleop_ws.py
